section_summary: This section contains documentation on education in occupied Japan from July to September 1948, compiled for the U.S. State Department. It includes the concluding portion of a statistical roster of educational institutions in Gifu Prefecture, diplomatic despatches and pouch transmittals forwarding publications and errata sheets on Japanese educational reform, and the initial section of a special report providing statistical tables and institutional rosters for Hiroshima Prefecture. The materials document post-World War II Japanese school administration, teacher and student populations, and SCAP-sponsored education reforms.

subfiles.about: Continuation of the statistical roster and directory of educational institutions in Gifu Prefecture, concluding with elementary, private, special schools, and a regional reference map.
subfiles.from: Civil Information and Education Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: This section concludes the directory and statistical roster of educational institutions in Gifu Prefecture. It details village and town elementary schools, kindergartens, private secondary and vocational schools, miscellaneous institutions, and schools under other government ministries as of 1946. It ends with summary data and a reference map of Central Honshu.
subfiles.title: Roster of Japanese Educational Institutions: Gifu Prefecture

subfiles.from: Civil Information and Education Section, GHQ SCAP
subfiles.summary: This report provides a comprehensive survey and statistical analysis of educational institutions in Hiroshima Prefecture for April and November 1946. It includes an explanatory introduction on the Japanese school system, summary tables classified by school level, type, and administrative jurisdiction, and begins the institutional roster for higher education institutions under the Ministry of Education.
subfiles.title: Roster and Statistics of Japanese Educational Institutions: Part 11, Hiroshima Prefecture
